concept: 认识论分级 (Epistemic Grading) — what level of knowledge does the scheme claim
core_claim_zh: 每个主张分级为描述/预测/规范，注明知识基础——让方案对自己的认知边界诚实。
core_claim_en: Every claim is graded description/prediction/normative with its knowledge base — honesty about the scheme's epistemic boundaries.

grade_definitions.description: 描述——可观察事实或公开记录
grade_definitions.prediction: 预测——基于方法论或行业报告的推论，未现场验证
grade_definitions.normative: 规范——设计建议，概念而非审定
